core_meaning.short_meaning: Vigilant guardian; trusted companion Muayqib ibn Abi Fatima, keeper of the Prophet's seal.
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Muayqib (مُعَيْقِيب) is an Arabic masculine given name meaning 'vigilant guardian', 'faithful keeper of trust', or 'steadfast successor'. In Islamic history, it is the renowned name of Muayqib ibn Abi Fatima ad-Dawsi, the trusted companion whom the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Abu Bakr, and Umar appointed as the official custodian of the prophetic signet ring and the public treasury.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Diminutive of ʿāqib (one who follows closely and guards with vigilant care), signifying trustworthiness, precision, and loyal oversight.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The root ʿ-q-b signifies following, guarding what comes after, and preserving trust. Muayqib embraced Islam early in Mecca, migrated to Abyssinia and then to Medina. Because of his scrupulous honesty, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ entrusted him with his personal signet ring (Khatam an-Nabi). Both Caliph Abu Bakr and Caliph Umar continued this absolute trust, making him overseer of the central treasury of the Caliphate.
